keyEvents.text: Goal! Roma 1, Sassuolo 0. Mario Hermoso (Roma) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner.
Own Goal by Sebastian Walukiewicz, Sassuolo. Roma 2, Sassuolo 0.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Kieron Bowie replaces Nemanja Matic.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Ignace Van der Brempt replaces Simone Cinquegrano.
Goal! Roma 3, Sassuolo 0. Rodrigo Mora (Roma) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Donyell Malen.
Substitution, Roma. Niccolò Pisilli replaces Rodrigo Mora.
Substitution, Roma. Marten de Roon replaces Manu Koné.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Luca Lipani replaces Kristian Thorstvedt.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Vasilije Adzic replaces Sebastiano Esposito.
Substitution, Roma. Santiago Castro replaces Donyell Malen.
Substitution, Roma. Konstantinos Koulierakis replaces Mario Hermoso.
Substitution, Roma. Daniele Ghilardi replaces Leonardo Balerdi.
